question_en: When reviewing an E-27.02 system problem, what evidence should be collected and evaluated?
options: A detailed malfunction description, diagnostic test results, previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_en: E-27.02 requires a malfunction description, diagnostic testing and evaluation using previous, manufacturer and commissioning information.
explanation_es: E-27.02 exige descripción de la falla, pruebas de diagnóstico y evaluación con información previa, del fabricante y commissioning.

question_en: Which evidence best demonstrates that an E-27.02 component change was completed correctly?
options: Verification test results plus updated documentation reflecting the system change.
explanation_en: E-27.02 requires verification of replacement components and documentation updates for system changes.
explanation_es: E-27.02 exige verificar componentes reemplazados y actualizar la documentación de cambios del sistema.
